resources.string: Motion stays; still background, no lyrics blur. Up to 60 fps.
Still background and seek bar, no blur or bounce. Up to 30 fps.
Your own mix of the switches below.
Stops every decorative animation, like your phone’s “Remove animations”. Overrides the effects below.
Paused while Reduce motion is on.
Pages slide and fade; the cover glides into place when the player opens or the song changes.
Buttons spring back with a small bounce; play and pause wobble when they switch.
The player’s colors drift slowly. Off: the same colors, standing still.
Lines far from the one being sung go soft (Android 12 and later).
The sung line fills in word by word. Off: the whole line lights up at once.
The wavy bar flows while music plays. Off: the wave stays still.
Animations follow your screen, up to 120 frames a second.
At most 60 frames a second. Saves work on 90 and 120 Hz screens.
At most 30 frames a second: half the drawing, a little less fluid.
Your phone’s “Remove animations” is on, so Mowj stays still whatever you choose here.
Battery saving is on right now, so motion and blur are paused.

string-array.name: settings_perf_tips
string-array.item: Try Balanced first: it turns off only the two heaviest layers.
Still stuttering? Light also stills the seek bar and word-by-word lyrics.
Battery saving and your phone’s “Remove animations” turn effects off too.
None of this changes how your music sounds.
